notes.text: Kiddushin 66a in the William Davidson Edition – Vocalized Aramaic has Elazar ben פועירה; this notice has פועירא. The two spellings are preserved. The supplied סו.. is rendered 66a, treating the doubled period as folio-side punctuation and terminal stop.
Pu’ira is a conventional vocalization; this name listing supplies no additional personal title or biography.
